outcome: Emergency caesarean section for failure to progress
Emergency caesarean section for other indications
Emergency caesarean section for any indication
cohort: Women who had an ultrasound in pregnancy between 36(+0/7) to 38(+6/7) weeks at Royal Prince Alfred Hospital from January 2005 to June 2009.
finding: Components of fetal biometry in the third trimester, specifically estimated fetal weight, biparietal diameter, and abdominal circumference, are associated with intrapartum caesarean section for failure to progress.
mod_finding: Components of fetal biometry in the third trimester are associated with intrapartum caesarean section for failure to progress.
